definitions.gloss: chapel; prayer hall; place of worship
definitions.explanation: A building or room used for Christian worship services or prayer. Can refer to a standalone chapel or a worship space within a larger building like a university or hospital.

examples.japanese: {礼拝堂|れいはいどう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{祈|いの}り→祈り：13732_inori⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{捧|ささ}げた→捧げる：02055_sasageru⟧。
examples.english: I offered prayers in the chapel.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{大学|だいがく}→大学：00608_daigaku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{美|うつく}しい→美しい：01121_utsukushii⟧{礼拝堂|れいはいどう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: This university has a beautiful chapel.

examples.japanese: ⟦{中世|ちゅうせい}→中世：05524_chuusei⟧⟦ヨーロッパ→ヨーロッパ：00427_yooroppa⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{礼拝堂|れいはいどう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{見事|みごと}→見事：03744_migoto⟧なステンド⟦グラス→グラス：00076_gurasu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{残|のこ}されている→残す：01975_nokosu⟧。
examples.english: Medieval European chapels still have magnificent stained glass windows.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{礼拝|れいはい}→礼拝：16972_reihai⟧ (worship, prayer) + {堂|どう} (hall, building). Refers primarily to Christian chapels and prayer halls. In Japan, {礼拝堂|れいはいどう} is found at Christian schools, hospitals, wedding venues, and churches.

Note that ⟦{礼拝|れいはい}→礼拝：16972_reihai⟧ can also be read らいはい in Buddhist contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {礼拝堂|れいはいどう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{礼拝|れいはい}→礼拝：16972_reihai⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to worship in the chapel
- {礼拝堂|れいはいどう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{集|あつ}まる→集まる：01162_atsumaru⟧: to gather in the chapel
- ⟦{大学|だいがく}→大学：00608_daigaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{礼拝堂|れいはいどう}: university chapel
- {礼拝堂|れいはいどう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{鐘|かね}→鐘：02654_kane⟧: chapel bell

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{教会|きょうかい}→教会：01387_kyoukai⟧: church — a broader term for a Christian church or congregation
- チャペル: chapel — the loanword, often used for wedding chapels in Japan
- ⟦{聖堂|せいどう}→聖堂：18663_seidou⟧: cathedral, sanctuary — a larger or more important place of worship
